entry-000: ARE YOU SURE YOU WANT TO EXIT?

IN AN ATTACK ON THE AUDITORE FAMILY VILLA, RODRIGO'S SON, CESARE, HAS KILLED EZIO'S BELOVED UNCLE, MARIO, AND STOLEN THE DANGEROUS AND POWERFUL APPLE OF EDEN. VOWING TO AVENGE HIS UNCLE AND RECOVER THE APPLE, EZIO SEEKS THE AID OF HIS FRIEND, NICCOLÒ MACCHIAVELLI, WHO INFORMS HIM THAT HE WON'T BE ABLE TO GET TO CESARE WITHOUT HELP FROM LOCALS...
YOU FOUND A MEMORY BLOCK! COLLECT \34\0 OF THEM TO EXPAND YOUR LIFEBAR.

THANKS TO THE BROTHERS, EZIO HAS FINALLY DEFEATED CESARE, THEREBY KILLING HIS NEMESIS AND ELIMINATING THE DARK SHADOW PLAGUING ROME. HAVING AVENGED HIS MURDERED UNCLE AND BROTHERS, HE ONLY WISHES TO LIVE IN PEACE AND REST.

HOWEVER, AS EZIO THOUGHT, THE APPLE OF EDEN HAS MANY POWERS THAT ARE BOTH MYSTERIOUS AND DANGEROUS. BEFORE HE LEAVES, EZIO HIDES THE APPLE OF EDEN SO THAT NONE MAY FIND IT OR USE ITS POWER. BUT WHAT EZIO DOESN'T KNOW IS THAT SPYING EYES ARE FOLLOWING HIS EVERY MOVEMENT...

entry-001:
LOCATION: ROME, COLOSSEUM
DATE: A.D. 1486
OBJECTIVE: KILL WOLFMEN

EZIO, WE FEARED YOU WERE DEAD! YOU SEEK REVENGE, BUT YOU MUST UNDERSTAND THAT ROMA BELONGS TO CESARE BORGIA NOW. HE'S NO FOOL; HIS AMBITION IS TO UNITE ALL ITALIA UNDER HIS RULE AND HE HAS THE WILL TO DO IT. YOU WON'T BE ABLE TO GET TO HIM WITHOUT HELP FROM LOCALS.
WHO, NICCOLÒ? I AM A STRANGER HERE; MY FAMILY'S VILLA HAS BEEN DESTROYED. WHO WOULD TRUST ME?

TRUST IS ONLY WON THROUGH SHARED INTEREST - AND SHARED ENEMIES. AN ASSASSIN NAMED CLAUDIO HAS BEEN CAPTURED BY BORGIA'S FANATICAL WOLFMEN, LED BY A MAN WHO CALLS HIMSELF ROMULUS. RESCUE CLAUDIO AND YOU'LL WIN THE ALLEGIANCE OF ROME'S ASSASSINS.
KEEP YOUR EYES OPEN, SOLDIER!
GUARD YOUR POST, SOLDIER!
THE ASSASSIN MAY BE NEARBY!
FIND HIM!
LOWER COLOSSEUM AREA
UPPER COLOSSEUM AREA
WE ARE BACK NOW, THE HOUR OF VENGEANCE DRAWS NEAR.
MY BROTHER, LET'S MAKE THESE WOLVES HOWL!
WHATEVER YOU THINK YOU'RE DOING, I ADVISE YOU FOR YOUR OWN SAKE... STOP NOW.
THE WOLVES OF ROME CANNOT BE OPENLY DEFIED. IF YOU CONTINUE - YOU DIE.
YOU HAVE A PRISONER: CLAUDIO. RELEASE HIM TO ME AND I'LL LET YOU LIVE.
MALEDETTO IDIOTA! YOU'LL DIE FOR YOUR ARROGANCE.
SHALL WE SHOW THEM HOW A BIRD OF PREY HUNTS A WOLF?
I SEE ROMULUS, THE LEADER OF THE WOLFMEN, AHEAD. CONCEAL YOURSELF, AND WAIT FOR MY SIGNAL.
DON'T LET HIM GET AWAY!
WHO ARE YOU? YOU ARE PROHIBITED
FROM ENTERING THE UPPER COLOSSEUM DISTRICT.
LEAVE HERE AT ONCE. OR I'LL KILL YOU.
WELCOME BACK. YOU'RE THE ONE MACHIAVELLI SAID WOULD NEED OUR HELP, RIGHT?
YES.
THEN PROVE YOU ARE WORTH HELPING. HELP US FREE CLAUDIO FROM THE WOLFMEN. IF YOU SAVE HIM, WE WILL FOLLOW YOU UNTIL THE END.
WE HAVE A DEAL.
MOVE CLOSE TO YOUR ENEMY TO ACTIVATE YOUR SPECIAL ATTACK!
TOUCH THE AREA ABOVE THE ASSASSIN OR TOUCH VIRTUAL PAD UP TO BLOCK YOUR ENEMY'S ATTACK.
TOUCH THE ASSASSIN OR THE ATTACK ICON NOW TO LAUNCH YOUR SPECIAL ATTACK!
entry-002:
LOCATION: ROME
DATE: A.D. 1486
OBJECTIVE: ESCAPE
BENE, BROTHER! THE ASSASSINS ARE YOUR ALLIES NOW. BUT BORGIA'S MEN ARE HUNTING FOR YOU AS WE SPEAK. YOU MUST NOT BE CAPTURED. GO!
IF I SET THOSE CRATES ON FIRE AND FLY OVER THEM, THE HEAT DRAFT SHOULD LET ME CLIMB HIGHER!
THEY'RE FLYING BORGIA'S COLORS! I'LL DROP FLAMING PITCH ON THEIR HEADS!
KEEP TOUCHING THE ASSASSIN OR THE ATTACK ICON AND RELEASE WHEN YOU'VE FINISHED CHARGING FOR A BIGGER EXPLOSION!
entry-003:
LOCATION: FLORENCE
DATE: A.D. 1486
OBJECTIVE: KILL LUCREZIA & RESCUE CATERINA

BROTHER, I HAVE BAD NEWS. BORGIA KNOWS IT WAS YOU WHO KILLED HIS WOLFMEN AND FREED CLAUDIO. IN RETALIATION, HE HAS KIDNAPPED SOMEONE CLOSE TO YOU: THE CONTESSA CATERINA SFORZA. MY SOURCES TELL ME SHE'S BEING HELD BY CESARE'S SISTER, LUCREZIA. GO THERE, KILL LUCREZIA, AND FIND THE KEY TO THE CONTESSA'S CELL.
GRAZIE, NICCOLÒ. YOU'RE A TRUE FRIEND.
I GOT THE KEY. AND NOW, I HAVE TO GO QUICKLY. ANDIAMO!
HOW DARE YOU SHOW YOUR FACE HERE, ASSASSIN! I SWEAR BY MY BROTHER CESARE, YOU WILL NOT LEAVE WITH CATERINA ALIVE.
MY FIGHT IS NOT WITH YOU. GIVE ME THE KEY TO CATERINA'S CELL AND YOUR LIFE WILL BE SPARED.
ASSASSIN SCUM, YOU'RE NOTHING BUT A COMMON THIEF AND MURDERER!
VERY WELL. YOU LEAVE ME NO CHOICE.
entry-004:
LOCATION: FLORENCE
DATE: A.D. 1486
OBJECTIVE: KILL JUAN BORGIA
DID YOU HEAR SOMETHING?
NO, I HEARD NOTHING.
LOOKS LIKE EVERYTHING IS FINE.
MAYBE... WE'D BETTER STAY ALERT.
WELL DONE! CATERINA IS SAVED AND WE ARE GETTING CLOSER TO SUCCESS. NOW KILL THE BANKER JUAN BORGIA, CESARE'S MOST IMPORTANT BUSINESS PARTNER. THEN CESARE WILL BE WEAKENED.
NO! HE'S ESCAPING. I HAVE TO FIND A WAY TO STOP HIM!
ASSASSIN! KILL ME - AND YOUR OWN DEATH IS ASSURED.
TOUCH THE AREA ABOVE THE ASSASSIN TO JUMP, TOUCH THE AREA TO THE ASSASSIN'S RIGHT TO SPEED UP AND LEFT TO SLOW DOWN.
BUT THIS CROSSBOW MAY HELP ME.
ASSASSIN! DIE!
ASSASSIN!!! THE GENERAL HAS BEEN KILLED!!
WE MUST FIND THE ASSASSIN!!!
SO MANY GUARDS, I MUST FIND A WAY TO CROSS THIS BRIDGE QUICKLY.
SEEMS I CAN'T CATCH HIM WITHOUT A HORSE.
GRAZIE FOR YOUR CONCERN, BANKER.
BUT THE TIME HAS COME FOR YOU TO PAY FOR YOUR CRUELTY.
DO YOU THINK THE BORGIAS WILL TAKE FLORENCE AS THEY HAVE ROME?
AS LONG AS THEY PAY IN FLORINS, MEDICI, BORGIA, IT'S ALL THE SAME TO ME.
AND NO ONE IN THIS CITY HAS MORE FLORINS THAN JUAN BORGIA.
IT PAYS TO BE A MALEDETTO BASTARDO.
JUAN BORGIA IS ESCAPING! YOU HAVE FAILED...
entry-005:
LOCATION: ROME
DATE: A.D. 1486
OBJECTIVE: ESCAPE

BENE, BROTHER! YOU MUST GO AT ONCE TO VENICE; THE BORGIAS HAVE A POWERFUL ALLY THERE WHO MUST BE ELIMINATED. TAKE THE FLYING MACHINE. YOU'VE SEEN HIS FORCES ON THE TIBER RIVER BEFORE. MY ADVICE? DESTROY THE ENTIRE ARMADA. CESARE IS ARROGANT; SUCH A BLOW WILL MAKE HIM TREMBLE WITH FEAR -- AND A FEARFUL ENEMY MAKES MISTAKES.
entry-006:
LOCATION: VENICE
DATE: A.D. 1486
OBJECTIVE: KILL OCTAVIEN

BROTHER, THE BORGIAS ARE PROPPED UP BY FRENCH TROOPS UNDER THE COMMAND OF BARON OCTAVIEN DE VALOIS. CESARE DOES NOT SEE WHAT A WEAK AND FICKLE CRUTCH HE LEANS ON. KILL OCTAVIEN AND THE FRENCH WILL WITHDRAW... AND BORGIA WILL FALL WITH THEM.
I HAVE TO CATCH UP WITH HIM.
SOMEONE RAISED AN ALARM! TIME TO GET OUT OF HERE FAST!
BAD LUCK. THE WATER GATE IS CLOSED. I NEED TO FIND ANOTHER WAY TO CATCH HIM.
entry-007:
LOCATION: ROME, PANTHEON
DATE: A.D. 1486
OBJECTIVE: KILL MICHELOTTO
MICHELOTTO, CESARE'S RIGHT-HAND MAN, IS YOUR TARGET. HE IS DANGEROUS, SO YOU'LL HAVE TO BE CAREFUL.
HE'S AROUND HERE SOMEWHERE. I MUST TRY TO BLOCK HIS WAY WHEN HE IS LEAVING AND KILL HIM.
HE FOUND ME! I MUST GET TO CESARE.
BROTHERS! THEY HAVE FOUND THE OTHER GATE! BLOCK THEIR WAY!
THE GUARDS WILL BE HERE SOON; I MUST FIND A WAY TO GET OUT OF THIS TOWN.
HERO! PLEASE DON'T... I WILL GET YOU TO CESARE.
YOU SHOULD APOLOGIZE FOR MY UNCLE. GO TO HELL! YOU WILL SEE CESARE THERE SOON.
EXCELLENT! BROTHER, YOU HAVE ONLY ONE FINAL ISSUE: KILL CESARE!
NO ONE CAN PUT A STOP TO MY VENGEANCE!
entry-008:
LOCATION: ROME, COLOSSEUM
DATE: A.D. 1486
OBJECTIVE: KILL BORGIA & BRING BACK THE APPLE
BROTHER, BORGIA IS PREPARING TO FLEE. KILL HIM AND TAKE BACK THE APPLE OF EDEN.
GRAZIE, NICCOLÒ. BECAUSE OF YOUR HELP, MY FAMILY AND I WILL FINALLY BE AVENGED.
HOW DID YOU GET IN HERE? WHERE IS MICHELOTTO? WHERE ARE MY SOLDIERS? GUARDS, KILL HIM! TEAR THE MALEDETTO BASTARDO TO PIECES!
SAVE YOUR BREATH, CESARE. MICHELOTTO IS DEAD, AS ARE YOUR MEN. RETURN THE APPLE OF EDEN TO ME AND SURRENDER.
THE DEMANDS OF A PETTY AUDITORE MEAN NOTHING TO ME! I AM DESTINED TO RULE ALL ITALIA!
I MADE A MISTAKE WHEN I SPARED YOUR FATHER'S LIFE. I WILL NOT MAKE THE SAME MISTAKE AGAIN. THIS COLOSSEUM WILL BE YOUR TOMB.
MAY NO ONE REMEMBER YOUR NAME. REQUIESCAT IN PACE.
